jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: All Open Positions Software Engineer Open Tel Aviv Full-time Hybrid We build models that predict and reason about physical systems — and we're deploying them into industrial environments where reliability matters. We need someone to own how our software gets to production and stays there. You'll define the production standards, shape the deployment architecture, and make sure what we ship to clients actually works — on their hardware, in their private clouds, under real-time constraints. Small team, high ownership, big impact. What you'll own: • Own the production platform — define how code moves from research prototype to client deployment • Build and maintain real-time backend services that consume model outputs and interface with physical equipment • Design and operate the deployment infrastructure — Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, on-prem and private-cloud delivery • Make multi-client delivery repeatable — same product, different environments, minimal manual work • Set production standards across the codebase — structure, testing, type safety, observability • Build monitoring and observability for systems running in environments we don't fully control • Integrate with industrial communication protocols (PLC, Modbus, OPC UA) and external systems • Work closely with research and AI engineering teams — you're the one who decides what "production-ready" means You might be a fit if: • Strong Python backend experience — you write clean, well-structured code with tests • Experience building and shipping real-time or low-latency systems • Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (designing pipelines, not just using them) • Track record of improving inherited codebases — refactoring incrementally, not rewriting • Pragmatic about technical debt: you fix what matters, not what bothers you aesthetically • On-prem or private-cloud deployment experience • You've dealt with the messy reality of deploying to environments you don't own Bonus points: • MLOps basics: Experience in automating the ML lifecycle, including model versioning (MLflow/DVC), automated retraining pipelines, and managing model registries. • Familiarity with industrial protocols (PLC, Modbus, OPC UA) or similar low-level networking • Experience with gRPC / protobuf service architectures • Distributed systems and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) • Exposure to LLM/agent infrastructure (RAG, vector databases, agent frameworks) • Monitoring and observability in production (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar) • Deploying mission-critical systems in industrial or regulated environments Join us to build physics-informed foundation models to enable human AI collaboration where it really matters • Please send your CV with the job title and your name as the subject line. To apply, send your CV to alfred@ai-maverick.com

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: All Open Positions AI Engineer Open Tel Aviv Full-time Hybrid We're looking for an AI Engineer to build LLM-based systems that extract structured knowledge from documents and enable intelligent reasoning over complex systems. You'll work at the intersection of document understanding, knowledge graphs, and RAG systems — turning unstructured knowledge (manuals, technical documents, domain-specific data) into queryable, actionable intelligence. What you'll own: • Design and build LLM-based pipelines for parsing and structuring information from technical documents and diagrams • Build and maintain knowledge bases using vector and graph databases • Build proprietary agentic systems for production deployment • Integrate LLM and CV models into end-to-end extraction pipelines • Develop graph-based RAG systems for reasoning over structured knowledge • Create evaluation metrics and benchmarks to measure pipeline and RAG quality • Research, prototype, and deploy model distillation approaches for production systems • Iterate on prompt engineering, retrieval strategies, and pipeline orchestration • Collaborate with research and software engineering teams You might be a fit if: • Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications (multi-step pipelines, not just API calls) • Experience with RAG systems: embedding, retrieval, reranking, generation • Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant) and/or graph databases (Neo4j) • Strong Python and ML tooling (PyTorch, HuggingFace, LangChain/LlamaIndex or similar) • Experience with LLM output evaluation — metrics, benchmarks, human-in-the-loop • Solid software engineering fundamentals — code quality, testing, version control Bonus points: • Foundation model fine-tuning (SFT, QLoRA, RLHF) • Experience with document parsing / OCR pipelines (PDF extraction, diagram understanding) • Knowledge graphs and ontologies • Experience with LangChain / LangGraph • Integrating CV models into multi-modal pipelines • Background in industrial, scientific, or regulated domains • Model distillation and compression techniques Join us to build physics-informed foundation models to enable human AI collaboration where it really matters • Please send your CV with the job title and your name as the subject line. To apply, send your CV to alfred@ai-maverick.com

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: All Open Positions ML Engineer Open Tel Aviv Full-time Hybrid We're looking for a Data/ML Engineer to build and maintain the data and ML pipelines that power Maverick's AI products. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, ML research, and production systems — combining computer vision, graph processing, NLP, and domain-specific ML to turn raw data (engineering documents, sensor streams, structured datasets) into structured, actionable knowledge. What you'll own: • Design and implement data preprocessing pipelines for multi-modal inputs (images, graphs, time series, text) • Train ML models from scratch for computer vision, NLP, and graph-based tasks • Build and optimize models for production deployment • Create and maintain evaluation frameworks with appropriate metrics • Work with synthetic and real-world data across diverse domains • Collaborate with research and software engineering teams • Contribute to research efforts and experimentation when needed You might be a fit if: • Strong Python and ML framework experience (PyTorch preferred) • Hands-on experience training ML models from scratch • Experience with computer vision, NLP, and/or graph ML • Solid understanding of ML evaluation methodology • Comfortable with data exploration and pipeline engineering • Production ML experience (training, deployment, monitoring) Bonus points: • Published research or strong technical writing • Experience with industrial/engineering documents • Graph neural networks or structured prediction • Domain adaptation / transfer learning • Foundation model fine-tuning or RAG systems • Experience with large-scale data processing Join us to build physics-informed foundation models to enable human AI collaboration where it really matters • Please send your CV with the job title and your name as the subject line. To apply, send your CV to alfred@ai-maverick.com

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description: All Open Positions Research Engineer Open Tel Aviv Full-time Hybrid We're an Early-Stage startup on the hunt for a hands-on, Research Engineer who lives and breathes models, math, physics, and vision. We work fast, take full ownership, and value independence. What you'll own: • Research and development for our core time series and vision models. • Designing and implementing training and inference infrastructure (GPU orchestration, experiment management, model serving). • Bridging the research-to-production gap: turning prototype ML code into deployable, maintainable systems. • Driving MLOps best practices, including model versioning, monitoring, and quality assurance. You might be a fit if: • You have deep experience with time-series or vision models, specifically in an R&D context. • You've taken messy research code and shipped it as a reliable service—more than once. • You're comfortable with PyTorch and experiment tracking tools (W&B, MLflow, etc.). • You've set up and managed training pipelines on cloud GPUs (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and dealt with spot instances, checkpointing, and cost optimization. Management • You can design and maintain robust CI/CD and MLOps pipelines. • You're pragmatic about technical debt: you fix what matters, not what bothers you aesthetically. Bonus points: • Familiarity with distributed training frameworks. • You've deployed ML systems in regulated or industrial environments. • You have strong opinions on MLOps and infrastructure. Together we will tackle two core problems: • How we can imitate human level logic from protocols, manuals and schematics. • How we can forecast dynamic systems in zero shot. Join us to build physics-informed foundation models to enable human AI collaboration where it really matters • Please send your CV with the job title and your name as the subject line. To apply, send your CV to alfred@ai-maverick.com
